title: The lid was a disappointment
text: The lid was a disappointment. I got this because I drink a lot of diet coke, it's the only soda we keep in the house, and I thought this would make it easier to store in the fridge, especially because of the lid, that way I could put stuff on the lid. Unfortunately the lid doesn't really fit all that well, it pops off super easy, and at this point I feel like I have to tape it onto the plastic just to get it to stay or just throw the lid away. I wish I had purchased a different one because the lid issue is driving me crazy.
